WhatIsPWA.title: What is PWA?
WhatIsPWA.subtitle: Progressive Web App is the Next Generation of App Distribution
WhatIsPWA.desc: It's not just a website, it's a super app that can be "installed" on the user's desktop. It combines the flexibility of the Web with the immersive experience of a Native App, completely freeing you from app store restrictions.
WhatIsPWA.feature1_desc: No redirection to Google Play. Install directly from the browser, shortening the conversion path by 50%.
WhatIsPWA.feature2_desc: Full-screen execution, home screen icon, and standalone launch. Feels exactly like a native app.
WhatIsPWA.feature3_desc: Based on browser technology, there is no risk of certificate revocation, ensuring asset security.

FAQ.title: FAQ - PWA Encapsulation & Attribution
FAQ.subtitle: Professional answers about PWA/APK encapsulation, intelligent cloaking, and attribution technology
FAQ.q1: Do I need to provide source code for PWA?
FAQ.a1: No. You only need to provide your H5 website URL and related Logo assets. We handle the encapsulation without touching your code.
FAQ.q2: Will PWA apps be banned by Google Play?
FAQ.a2: Absolutely not. PWAs run on browser technology and do not rely on app store distribution, so there is zero risk of bans, takedowns, or account association.
FAQ.q3: Which third-party platforms does the attribution system support?
FAQ.a3: We are fully compatible with mainstream ad & attribution platforms including AppsFlyer, Adjust, Facebook Pixel, TikTok Pixel, and Kwai Ads, supporting full-link data postback.
FAQ.q4: How long does PWA encapsulation or APK packaging take?
FAQ.a4: PWA encapsulation and W2A (Web-to-APK) are two separate functions, but both are highly efficient. Our automated process typically completes either packaging within 10 minutes, supporting custom signatures and package names.
FAQ.a5: We operate on a flexible pre-recharge model. You can top up any amount (min. $100) in the dashboard, and the system automatically deducts fees based on actual PWA installs or W2A downloads ($0.01 per action). Pay as you go, with no expiration on your balance, so you don't have to worry about high upfront costs or wasted funds. Volume discounts are available for large clients.
FAQ.a6: Certainly. Please contact our business team to get free test credits and experience the full process yourself.
FAQ.a7: We only support USDT top-ups. This ensures maximum payment privacy and fund security for both parties, avoiding risks associated with traditional fiat payments.
FAQ.a8: Yes. For clients with high data security requirements, we offer private deployment upon payment of a deposit. You will need to provide server resources and domain access, and we will handle the deployment and delivery.
FAQ.q9: Is there a minimum recharge amount?
FAQ.a9: Yes, the minimum recharge amount is $100. This is to ensure that every client receives high-quality technical support and server resources. We are committed to serving long-term partners, and frequent small transactions would increase operational costs. We appreciate your understanding.

Legal.privacy_meta_desc: Learn how PWA.ad collects, uses, and protects your personal information. We are committed to ensuring your data security and privacy.
Legal.privacy_content:
Last Updated: March 1, 2024

Welcome to PWA.ad (hereinafter referred to as "we" or "us"). We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy details how we collect, use, store, and protect your information.

1. Information Collection
To provide you with precise PWA encapsulation, attribution analysis, and ad optimization services, we may collect the following information:
- **Contact Information**: When you submit a consultation form, we collect your Telegram ID, business link, business type, and requirements to allow our business team to contact you.
- **Device & Log Information**: We automatically collect your IP address, browser type, language settings, access time, and source (e.g., referral sites, ad parameters) to analyze traffic sources, optimize website experience, and prevent malicious attacks.
- **Business Data**: When using our PWA encapsulation or attribution services, the H5 links, Logo assets, and attribution data (e.g., installs, registrations) you provide are used solely for service provision and never for other commercial purposes.

2. Information Use
We use the collected information to:
- Process your business requests and provide PWA encapsulation, APK generation, and attribution integration services.
- Send service updates, technical support, or promotional notifications via Telegram or other contact methods.
- Analyze website traffic and user behavior to optimize our product features and page design.
- Comply with legal obligations to ensure platform and user security.

3. Information Sharing & Disclosure
We promise to keep your information strictly confidential unless:
- **With your explicit consent**.
- **Required by law**: In response to mandatory requests from courts, government agencies, or legal processes.
- **Service Necessity**: To complete attribution integration, we may need to postback non-sensitive data (e.g., attribution events) to your specified third-party platforms (e.g., AppsFlyer, Adjust, Facebook).

4. Data Security
We employ industry-leading security technologies (e.g., SSL encryption, access control, firewalls) to protect your data. For sensitive payment information, we only support USDT cryptocurrency payments to maximize your fund and identity privacy.

5. Cookies
We use Cookies to record your preferences and analyze traffic. You can refuse Cookies through your browser settings, but this may affect the use of some functions.

6. Policy Updates
We may update this policy based on business development. Significant changes will be notified via website announcements or direct notifications.

If you have any questions, please contact our support team via Telegram.
